title: Business Associations
audience: a law student in a U.S. JD program
purpose: Analyze agency, partnerships, limited liability companies and corporations: formation, piercing the veil, fiduciary duties (care, loyalty and good faith), the business judgment rule, shareholder voting and rights, derivative suits, mergers and acquisitions, and basic securities law.

weeks.7: The duty of care and the business judgment rule
weeks.8: The duty of loyalty and conflicted transactions
weeks.12: Securities basics: Rule 10b-5 and insider trading

blocks.deliverable: Decide whether a principal is bound by an agent's contract.
Advise a client on the best form for a new business.
Week 7 midterm; analyze a director's conflicted transaction.
Decide whether demand on the board is excused.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Client advice file: for a supplied start-up with three founders, recommend a business form, draft key operating-agreement provisions, and write a memo on the founders' fiduciary duties in a supplied conflict.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
